newsitem.title: UK: George - Stg unlikely to join EMU at current level.
newsitem.headline: George - Stg unlikely to join EMU at current level.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Monday he would be very surprised, if Britain were to join European economic and monetary union (EMU), if sterling were to go in at its current exchange rate.
"If sterling were to join monetary union, I'd be very surprised if it were at anything like this level in the exchange rate," George told parliament's Treasury select committee.
Responding to a question about whether financial markets were being effected by a view, held by some market participants, that sterling is a "one-way" bet for the near term, George said:
"We do hear that point of view, but I just don't find it a very convincing one."
He said that any assumption that sterling would enter Europe's currency union at its current level was "an extremely strong assumption."
